## Summary of Changes

A concise description of what this PR does, why it is needed, and any architectural context.

## Related Issue(s)

Closes # (or References #)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring or maintenance

## Verification Checklist

Please verify before requesting review:

- [ ] My code follows the code style and guidelines described in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] I have added automated tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes (`pytest` in `api/`)
- [ ] Frontend checks pass without errors (`npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint` in `web/`)
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation (e.g. `README.md`, `DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md`)
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published in downstream modules
